item.title: Ozempic Misuse: GLP-1 Drugs, Anorexia, Bulimia, and Eating Disorder Relapse
item.description: Experts explain how GLP-1 drugs can trigger eating disorder relapse by mimicking symptoms and disrupting intuitive eating signals. Learn how to stay safe.

item.title: Obesity and Mobility: How to Keep Light on Your Feet
item.description: Learn how to protect your mobility and reduce joint pain when you have obesity through stretching, low-impact cardio, strength training, and more.

item.title: A Widowmaker Heart Attack Isn’t Always Deadly — Here’s How I Know
item.description: A panicked call to a 911 operator who guided her through CPR helped one woman save her partner’s life. But the episode took a toll on them both.

item.title: Could Adding a Little More Meat to Your Diet Help Stave Off Alzheimer’s Disease?
item.description: A new study found that eating more meat was linked to better cognitive outcomes in people with a genetic risk for Alzheimer’s. But the research has some important caveats.

item.title: What Is Mental Illness?
item.description: Learn about the symptoms, diagnostic process, and treatment options for mental health conditions like anxiety and depression here.

item.title: What Is Dementia?
item.description: There are many types of dementia, including vascular dementia, frontotemporal dementia, Alzheimer’s dementia, and Lewy body dementia. Read on to learn the signs, symptoms, and treatments for each.

item.title: Why Better Sleep Can Help You Live Longer
item.description: Research links poor sleep to a shorter lifespan and faster cellular aging. Learn how quality sleep protects your brain, heart, immune system, and more.

item.title: Plant-Based Diets: Can They Help Treat Crohn
item.description: Find out how eating a plant-based diet that limits or omits meat may reduce your chances of experiencing active symptoms and increase beneficial bacteria in the gut.

item.title: Pulsatile Tinnitus: What It Means if You Hear a Pulse in Your Ear
item.description: A doctor explains the common (and not so common) reasons that you might hear a pulse in your ear, also known as pulsatile tinnitus. Plus, when to see a doctor.

item.title: What to Eat for Heart Health: The Top 9 Dietary Rules
item.description: The American Heart Association just released new guidance on dietary priorities for heart health. Learn what they say about protein, grains, and other essentials.

item.title: What Are Obesity Classes? Understanding How the Obesity Grading System Can Impact Treatment
item.description: Learn how doctors categorize obesity into classes using BMI, as well as related health risks and treatments based on the obesity grading system.

item.title: What Causes Obesity?
item.description: Obesity is a complex disease driven by more than just diet. Discover how genetics, environment, stress, and medical factors can also contribute to weight gain.

item.title: 7 Tips for Boosting Energy With Obesity
item.description: If you have obesity, you may experience fatigue from carrying extra weight or from related conditions. Learn how lifestyle changes can help you feel better.

item.title: What Is Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)?
item.description: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a chronic bowel disorder that may result in diarrhea or constipation. Find out how it’s diagnosed and treated.

item.title: Foods That Accelerate Aging: 7 to Avoid
item.description: From ultra-processed foods to alcohol, certain dietary choices can speed up biological aging. Learn which 7 foods to limit and why, according to dietitians.
